events.speaker: BIRDIE
events.text: Didn't mean to walk right up on your fire. I'll move on if you want the quiet back.

events.speaker: BIRDIE
events.text: Here. Camp always sounds better with something other than the wind in it.

events.speaker: BIRDIE
events.text: A place, not a favor. I can cook, and I don't scare at a long day.

events.speaker: BIRDIE
events.text: You asked me to sing again before you asked what was wrong. I noticed that.

events.speaker: BIRDIE
events.text: Whit sent word the fence line held. That's his way of saying he misses me. Neither of us will say it plainer.
